notes: Uber Eats order receipts use the same shell as Uber ride receipts but a different set of modules. Removed: the rate and tip block for the courier; the app download and Download PDF buttons, and the two disclaimer rows they sat in, since a defused link leaves the words switch your payment method and download the receipt in a PDF format on a page that can do neither; the review your order history row, taken at the info table that holds its label and its link, while the order completed row beside it stays because it carries the delivery time; the merchant and dish photography served from S3, whose paths identify the real merchant; the social link row; the corporate address footer and the account and terms link cluster; and the support panel, matched at the wrapper that holds it so the heading and the message go with the button. The Uber One savings strip has a pattern here and is kept anyway: it prints the $14.55 it saved, and the amount guard skips a pattern that would take an amount with it, so the strip stays as part of what the order cost. Kept verbatim: every basket line with its quantity and options, the subtotal, the delivery and service fees, the tax, every discount and credit row, the order total, the order date and the order completed timestamp, both tender rows when a voucher and a card split the bill, and the card last four. Uber Eats and Uber ride mail share the sender domain uber.com, so the domain alone cannot name the folder; detect_vendor prefers the vendor whose subject patterns also fit, and an order subject resolves here while a trip subject resolves to uber. Nothing here is rewritten, so this folder carries no replace pairs. The order total sits in the same two cell row an Uber ride total sits in, and the same thing holds it on one line: the packet scopes each receipt's stylesheet to its own card, so the row lays itself out inside that card rather than against the width of the page. Timing and reading: an order receipt lands within a day of the delivery. A voucher and a card can split the bill, so both tender rows matter, the basket subtotal is the meal line, and the pickup and delivery rows carry both endpoints.
